subject.title: codex app-server drops guardianWarning on rejection circuit-breaker interrupts

question: Should the protected maintainer-labeled Codex app-server bug be prioritized for a narrow projector fix now, and who should own the Codex-side review?
rationale: The bug is source-proven and narrow, but the protected `maintainer` label means ClawSweeper should not auto-close or queue repair without explicit maintainer handling.

options.title: Prioritize narrow projector fix

options.title: Defer behind Codex runtime maintenance
options.body: Leave this open as maintainer-owned Codex app-server work if the team wants to batch it with a broader protocol/event projection pass.

recommendation.title: Prioritize narrow projector fix
